style: Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail

items.subject: A cheerful kid paint-runner figure crouched low in a surfing stance, knees bent, arms out for balance, facing forward, wearing a cream-white hoodie, dark plum shorts and chunky cobalt-blue sneakers, wavy magenta hair locks with mint, red and yellow paint-dipped tips, cyan tinted sport goggles pushed onto the face, a small round glass paint tank backpack with brass straps

A festive fairground paint-festival finish arch gateway: two tall cream-ivory round columns standing on turned brass plinths with rose-pink and mint-green bands, joined at the top by a gently curved ivory arch beam with brass clasp rings, a golden paint-pot finial with blue paint on top of the keystone, a row of colourful scalloped pennant flags hanging under the arch, a fan of rainbow paint-stripe rays at each column top, the opening between the columns completely clear and wide

A cute rounded egg-shaped mascot robot with a glossy ivory and plum body, a wraparound cyan visor with two big glossy cartoon eyes, a crest of four curly paint-splash locks on top in mint, red, yellow and blue, two arms stretched straight out sideways each holding a fluffy cylindrical paint roller, the left roller rose pink and the right roller mint green, standing on a short round brass base

A glossy collectible power-up charm: a plump upright teardrop of swirled rainbow paint (violet, red, blue, yellow, mint bands) with a polished gold ring around its middle, four small coloured four-point star petals around the ring, and a tiny glowing warm bead on its tip
A glossy collectible power-up charm: an upright six-sided crest shield in sky-blue enamel with a raised polished gold bezel frame and a translucent pale-blue glass chevron raised in the centre

A glossy collectible power-up charm: two chunky interlocked golden yellow five-point stars standing upright, one slightly behind and tilted from the other, a polished brass gyroscope ring around them and a glowing amber gem in the centre

A glossy collectible power-up charm: an upright round disc made of two curled teardrop paint swirls hugging each other, one teal and one coral, framed by a polished brass ring with four small round gem pips in red, yellow, blue and purple around it

A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock with dangling roots underneath, a flat bright green grassy top with a little wooden artist deck, one round fluffy-canopied tree with a gently curved trunk, and three small paint pots in red, yellow and blue on the deck

A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock underneath, a flat grassy top carrying a tall slender steel lattice water tower painted plum with a big rounded cream water tank on top covered in colourful paint drips running down

A hot-air balloon with a round puffy envelope made of sixteen vertical gores in alternating red, cream, cobalt blue, golden yellow, magenta and mint, a brass burner ring, ropes down to a small woven wicker basket

A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock underneath, a flat grassy top with a giant tipped-over pale metal paint can pouring a thick glossy pink paint stream that pools in a shiny puddle on the grass

A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock underneath, a flat grassy top holding a giant tilted wooden artist palette with plump swirled dabs of red, yellow, blue, mint and violet paint, and two giant crossed paintbrushes with wet tips

A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock underneath, a flat grassy top with a tall wooden tripod easel holding a canvas painted with bold abstract colour swirls in red, yellow, blue and mint, a wooden paint ledge

A cheerful kid paint-runner: cream-white hoodie with paint drips, dark plum shorts, chunky cobalt-blue sneakers, wavy magenta hair with mint, red and yellow paint-dipped tips, cyan tinted sport goggles
